query_text: late runway change during approach

This can result in a range of safety issues, including loss of control and accidents. The use of late runway changes can compromise the crew's ability to maintain situational awareness and make informed decisions.
key_hazards: Late runway changes; Loss of situational awareness; Unstabilized approach; Incorrect runway turn
recommended_phraseology: FREQUENCY CHANGE APPROVED | CLEARED APPROACH [RUNWAY (number)]

recommended_phraseology: FREQUENCY CHANGE APPROVED | CLEARED APPROACH [RUNWAY (number)]

query_text: different runway cleared after intercepting localizer
summary: Different runway cleared after intercepting localizer can lead to critical errors. This can cause the aircraft to overshoot the runway centerline or deviate from the intended course.
key_hazards: Intercepting localizer; Failure to rearm localizer; Incorrect runway capture; Deviation from intended course
recommended_phraseology: RUNWAY (number) CLEARED FOR TAKE-OFF [REPORT AIRBORNE] | RUNWAY (number) CLEARED TO LAND

query_text: controller switched landing runway due traffic

query_text: runway change while aircraft established on ILS
summary: A critical risk was identified in the incident reports where aircraft were established on Instrument Landing System (ILS) but experienced runway changes without the ILS updating, leading to unstable approaches and near-misses. The lack of timely updates and failure to report established on glide path or localizer resulted in these incidents. This highlights the importance of clear communication and timely updates in ILS operations.
key_hazards: Established on ILS without timely updates; Unstable approach; Runway change without ILS update; Failure to report established on glide path or localizer
recommended_phraseology: REPORT ESTABLISHED ON GLIDE PATH | REPORT ESTABLISHED ON LOCALIZER (or ON [GLS/RNP/MLS] [FINAL] APPROACH [COURSE])

query_text: change from intersecting to parallel runway during approach
summary: The incident reports highlight the risk of changing from an intersecting to a parallel runway during approach, which can lead to conflicts and NMACs. recommended_phraseology: REQUEST LEVEL (or FLIGHT LEVEL or ALTITUDE) CHANGE FROM (name of unit) [AT (time or significant point)] | CLEARED FOR (type of approach) APPROACH RUNWAY (number) LEFT (or RIGHT)

query_text: runway change while on short final with traffic ahead

recommended_phraseology: EXPEDITE CROSSING RUNWAY (number) TRAFFIC (aircraft type) (distance) (MILES) FINAL | (traffic information) RUNWAY (number) CLEARED TO LAND | (traffic information) RUNWAY (number) CLEARED FOR TAKE-OFF
